description: Extract structured facts from landed contract text; every quote is substring-checked against the landed page text.
instruction:
Extract the following facts from the landed contract page text.

counterparty_name: the legal name of the party contracting with the supplier,
exactly as written.

notice_period_days: the number of days' written notice required to terminate,
as an integer.

auto_renews: true if the agreement renews automatically absent notice, false if
it expires at the end of the term.

For every field, cite the verbatim span of the page text the value rests on.
Quote the span exactly as it appears — the harness checks that your quote is a
literal substring of the landed text, so a paraphrase will fail. If the page
does not state a field, return the absent sentinel and cite nothing.

target_fields.name: counterparty_name
target_fields.description: Legal name exactly as written. LENGTH is enforced by the harness — this API's JSON Schema has no minLength.

target_fields.name: notice_period_days
target_fields.description: Days of written notice required to terminate.

target_fields.name: auto_renews
target_fields.description: Whether the term renews automatically absent notice.
